reviews.author: Corayma Fontanez
reviews.text: I recently took my truck to this place and I couldn’t be happier with the service. The staff was very professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly. They did an amazing job and got my truck back on the road quickly. It’s hard to find honest and reliable mechanics, but this place definitely earned my trust. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Adam Spencer
reviews.text: "PLEASE" EVEN THOUGH THIS IS LONG PLEASE READ THIS POST!!!! BE VERY CAREFUL of this shop ( Camilo) !!!! I called and set up for his shop to repair my 2000 Volvo. Unfortunately my truck went down in October and I got the runaround until I found this shop I thought. He(Camilo) setup a price with me on taking my motor out fixing another one that I had. Just after a few week's of working on it he told his mechanic to call me and said that it was taking way to long and he wanted it out of the shop. After I had already paid them $4500.00 total and he said that he wanted for me to give him another $2000.00 for him completely doing NOTHING!!!! So I had to get some friends and go and get it moved and when I got there. My truck had extensive damage to my hood and bumper that now needs to be replaced. Also after paying all that I paid for most of it is being redone! He would even talk with me and only would text when asked about it, he said that it came in like that. So don't trust this place to work on your stuff!!!!

reviews.author: Mak Mak
reviews.text: Excellent work fast, reliable . My 2007 beaver marquis broke down two rear airbags failed. They're installing the new airbags and put me back on the road . The staff and manager are very respectful and professional. Manager drove two hours to get the new airbags. I will recommend this shop to anyone .

reviews.author: Ang Banz
reviews.text: great service! they did an excellent job on my truck- everything was done quickly and professionally.

reviews.author: Jason Hartsell
reviews.text: We had a driver mistakenly put diesel fuel into our gasoline truck. We got the vehicle towed to Supreme Garage and they took care of us. The guys were very friendly to work with and they got our tank drained, fuel lines cleaned out, and had us out the door the very next morning. I'll definitely give them our business in the future.

reviews.author: Tamaiky
reviews.text: I work for an RV Network and this guy traveled to another town on a Saturday night to get a serpentine belt that fits my customer’s RV that was having issues on the side of the interstate 77, everything went very well and they’re back on the road now (Just happened) also, very reasonable pricing!

reviews.author: Hermel Ortega
reviews.text: If you want fast service and fair prices, they are the ones to go for. Call these guys to repair your commercial trucks. I arrived with a damaged transmission on my truck, I had it towed from NY. Camilo helped me with all the logistics to tow the truck. We changed the clutch kit and actuators. The truck was back on the road in 3 days. Call them good service.

reviews.author: GTHC transportation
reviews.text: I normally don’t leave reviews, but Camilo and his guys did a great job. They got the parts and fixed my truck quickly at an excellent price. They are the best in NC. I recommend their services.

reviews.author: Todd Taylor
reviews.text: Had a punctured drive tire. Fixed me right up. What a great group of people. Friendly, kind, and overflowing with hospitality. We could use more garages like this.

reviews.author: William Helton
reviews.text: Camilo and his guys are the best! They are honest and they do their best to get you back on the road quickly. Yard is secure and safe they allow me to leave my truck there for over a week without aggravating me. I recently moved my business to Lexington and they are my new mechanics. Prices are fair as well.

reviews.author: Chris Elsaesser
reviews.text: I normally don’t leave reviews however I felt the need to. Without a doubt I will be a repeating customer. Best prices with quality work, with people you can actually trust and everyone treats you extremely nice. They actually take the time to listen to what your saying. Thank you for fixing my truck. Satisfied is an understatement! Thank you :) I’ve recommended my whole family to come see you when they have a problem. About time Lexington gets a good shop with honest people.

reviews.author: Victor Hernandez
reviews.text: Quick response, amazing prices, and quality work! Camilo had both of our Kenworth T270’s running and ready for the road within a few hours of me calling. Exactly how business should done. Thanks!

reviews.author: mts mts
reviews.text: Our truck was in that area with blown out tire, they fixed my truck quickly at an excellent price. I recommend their services, it is our go to shop in this area.

reviews.author: Nicholas Teel
reviews.text: Had a tire blowed out on the side of 85! Camillo and his guys got to me fast and replaced the tire and had be back on the road in a little over a hour! Easy to communicate with!

reviews.author: Tierra Felix
reviews.text: I usually don't do reviews but these guys were so great that I would be doing a disservice to others if I didn't share their greatness. We're Owner-Ops and my husband's air compressor (and lines) on his truck had broken/disconnected and he was over 600 miles away from home. It was super BAD timing and overly frustrating, as we had just lost his Grandmother and it was his first week back OTR after being out a couple weeks. After calling around hearing the high quotes just to come out, and potential repair costs, my husband decided to Uber for parts in an attempt to repair it himself. Nothing was working and he had already spent several hours in the heat - hot and HANGRY! Lol. Even worse, he was on a high traffic curve in what appeared to be a desolate area and the sun was going down soon. Right as he was about to give in to the expensive costs of others, the SUPREME GARAGE & ROAD SERVICE guys happened to pass him on their way to assist another trucker, quickly stopped and told him to give them a moment and they'll be right back to assist him, as the other trucker's needs would be quick. They came back, checked us out, told us the issue, worked hard to fix it roadside but it ultimately required in house repair and towing. They gave us the option to use them or whoever we chose and also provided us an affordable towing contact. No forced service, but of course we went with them and I'm glad we did! They provided us with a SUPER affordable towing company (Clark's Towing and Tire - Lexington, NC). We were worried about the cost for such a short distance and they assured us that it wouldn't be too bad as they refer many to them all the time; it wasn't! Lastly, they got us in immediately and advised on the amount of time and cost it would take to get the job done. They were done at said time which allowed us to still meet our load pick-up time. They even catered to my husband's hunger by ensuring that he had a way for food and provided him with something to drink. They repaired his truck and had us back on the road with no issues. They were friendly, fast, trustworthy, AFFORDABLE and most importantly, they KNEW what they were doing! We're so grateful for Supreme Garage & Road Service! They're definitely our go-to should we ever need repairs in their area again! Thank you guys for providing SUPREME service!

reviews.author: EasterIslandUFO EasterIslandUFO
reviews.text: Post thanksgiving, the wife was driving in from the coast on a dead battery. A good samaritan jumped the car at a gas station. I contacted multiple shops in the area after buying a new battery. No one was willing to install the new battery, as it was “too complicated” (much less pick up the phone on a holiday weekend). Helping a traveling loved one via iphone is easier said than done. Again, only one person ever got back to me: Supreme. Supreme Garage & Road Service LLC delivered. They installed the alleged “too difficult/need to go to a dealership” battery and had her and our cold chihuahua on the road in no time… highly recommended; fairly priced; has a full grasp of “emergency.”

reviews.author: Bejta
reviews.text: Great place to stop and fix your truck. The owner is a great guy and professional. I have been spending a lot more time and money other places,so I'm happy that I found this place so I dont have to worry much when my truck is going to break down. O I forgot something to mansion which is very important you can trust him.

reviews.author: WIZ Trans
reviews.text: Great service. They came out in a reasonable time and they got my guy moving. Would highly recommend these guys. Also reasonably priced!

reviews.author: Tammy Pringnitz
reviews.text: Absolutely the quickest most professional company i have ever used. Fast and very professional . Awesome company

reviews.author: Oscar's Carrier
reviews.text: Great service and price for what has done to my truck. You can really see the experience on their hands when it comes to repairing. 10/10

reviews.author: UMS LOGISTICS INC
reviews.text: These willing guys are very fast and having good communication, really. Another positive sides, there is not any taxes if u pay by cash. And any kind of payment methods available as well, appreciate it guys!

reviews.author: Emma Laguna
reviews.text: Professional team, attentive to the customer’s problems, and affordable. If you have problems with your vehicle and are in the area, give them a call. I recommend them 100%!

reviews.author: mustafadogan eker
reviews.text: I needed to change a tire. Even though they were about to close, they took care of my job in a short time. They were very kind and attentive.

reviews.author: Malena Machado
reviews.text: Great service!!! Thank you so much for your help with our driver Kevin. We appreciate your help Camilo.

reviews.author: Cody Vandyke
reviews.text: They told me they can’t work on anything but commercial vehicles after asking what kind of vehicle. Well first thing asked should’ve been is it a commercial vehicle.

reviews.author: juan mosquera
reviews.text: Great place to get your car,truck work done I had a problem with my truck and they fix it right away 5 starts for the shop definitely recommend this place .

reviews.author: Cristofer molina volquez
reviews.text: The service was excellent, truly the best. The mechanic was very attentive and highly professional. I truly recommend them; when you call, ask for Christopher, the mechanic who helped me.

reviews.author: Angel Alicea
reviews.text: Excellent service! They made my truck look brand new! Totally recommended! And for truck drivers looking for a place to stay, there it is. Thanks for the tamales, soda, and water! They look out for you! Thanks to your team as well. Blessings always! Very grateful. 100% RECOMMENDED

reviews.author: Rafael Ruiz
reviews.text: Quick response, excellent and professional roadside service. Reasonable price, I recommend it to anyone. Good roadside service, economical, fair prices. I recommend them for your needs.

reviews.author: roberto rodriguez
reviews.text: Excellent service and great customer service, 100% recommended and very grateful for their help. They speak Spanish and are attentive to your needs, they don't make you spend money on things you don't need.

reviews.author: Alex Fernandez
reviews.text: Excellent service. They speak Spanish, they assist you immediately and are very friendly. 100% recommended
